reason: The first eight proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper experiment, so they are one hypothesis, not independent evidence. Rank that experiment first: it is the only set aimed at timed n=512 and has a verified helper ABI, but no measured win; the fresh baseline is about 1035–1071 GFLOP/s, far below target, and added calls and SME transitions may erase any packing benefit. B-panel layout adds a 1 MiB copy and has unresolved compatibility with the generated kernel, so rank it next. Tail handling affects only the general fallback, not n=512, and explicit bounds and stores add correctness risk without expected target benefit.
